name: claude-second-brain-os
description: A modular foundation for a second brain on Claude Code, for any role: ingest Slack, Teams, Confluence and notes; keep projects, stakeholders and growth in markdown; get digests, a learning loop and a nightly steal list.

plugins.name: brain-core
plugins.description: Required. Setup wizard, doctor, the brain CLI, the knowledge-base index, projects/topics/people scaffolding, hooks, rules and personas.

plugins.name: brain-ingest
plugins.description: The orchestrator: runs every installed ingest brick in stages, with catch-up and a run log.

plugins.name: brain-ingest-slack
plugins.description: Slack: watched channels, messages you flag with a reaction, and who you owe a reply.

plugins.name: brain-ingest-teams
plugins.description: Meetings: Teams transcripts fetched through the Microsoft 365 connector, plus VTT/TXT transcript drops.

plugins.name: brain-ingest-confluence
plugins.description: Confluence: watched spaces and pages, re-ingested when they change.

plugins.name: brain-ingest-notes
plugins.description: Manual notes: drop markdown, text or pasted notes into an inbox and they join the pipeline.

plugins.name: brain-summarise
plugins.description: Meeting summaries with decisions and actions, plus todo extraction.

plugins.name: brain-wiki
plugins.description: Keeps project, people and topic pages current from the pending queue; ask questions, resolve contradictions, prune stale facts.

plugins.name: brain-digests
plugins.description: Weekly and monthly digests, with an approval-gated publish step.

plugins.name: brain-growth
plugins.description: Career growth: mine evidence from your work, set objectives, run objective reviews and self-reviews. Confidential by default.

plugins.name: brain-mentoring
plugins.description: Mentorships, as mentor or mentee: session prep, notes, goals and progress.

plugins.name: brain-stakeholders
plugins.description: People pages, org chart, stakeholder map and 1:1 prep drafts.

plugins.name: brain-learning-loop
plugins.description: Nightly session consolidation into memory with hypotheses and improvement proposals; weekly system review; rule promotion.

plugins.name: brain-steal-list
plugins.description: A nightly review of ideas you clipped from others' setups: what to steal, adapt or skip, tracked on a markdown status board.

plugins.name: brain-grill
plugins.description: Grill me: relentless, workspace-aware stress tests of PRDs, roadmaps, decisions and objectives.
